Claude Certified Architect — Foundations (CCAR-F) tests whether you can make sound trade-offs when you build real solutions with Claude. It spans Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, the Claude API, and MCP.

The exam is scenario-based. A live form draws 4 scenarios from a published bank of 6. This guide follows the official exam guide, task by task.
a7150d78f0:
Study loop: read one task statement, then close the guide. Explain the decision in your own words, and answer a scenario item. If you miss it, note why: concept recall, stem evidence, or a product fact. Revisit missed concepts the next day, and again a few days later.

The capstones and companion code are optional reinforcement. Use them when they clear up a weak concept, not as a prerequisite for sitting the exam.
